purpose: Teach: カルシウム/材質/耕作/司教/旧約/起立/見識/人身

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員食堂のカルシウムメニューを充実させろ
lines.en: Improve the calcium-rich menu options in the company cafeteria.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for negotiation in the tone, but not unkind—the voice of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品材質の見直しを進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll review the product sourcing to expand those options.
lines.style: Respectful and measured. Lean-forward posture in the voice. Taking mental notes visibly—not flustered, but attentive and ready. A nod embedded in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、耕作放棄地の再活用事業も検討しろ
lines.en: Also, explore a business plan for reclaiming abandoned agricultural land.
lines.style: Same clipped authority. Slight pause before the pivot to the new directive. The voice that's already thinking three steps ahead. Each instruction clear and discrete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の司教様との対話も視野に入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll include conversations with local agricultural leaders in our planning.
lines.style: Same attentive respect. A beat of processing the new directive. Writing it down mentally. Calm, capable, slightly more engaged than before—this is a larger initiative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧約のような厳格すぎる規律ではなく現代的経営をしろ
lines.en: And stop running the company with Old Testament rigidity. We need modern management practices.
lines.style: Firmer edge now. The voice that's making a philosophical point, not just giving orders. Slight emphasis on 'modern'—this is a correction, almost gentle, to how things have been. A moment of actual conviction underneath the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。朝礼での起立姿勢にこだわりません
lines.en: Yes. We'll stop being so rigid about posture during morning briefings.
lines.style: A small release in the voice—this one lands differently because it's a concrete example of what 'modern' means. Lighter, almost relieved. Still professional, but with a trace of wry understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の見識を高める研修を行え
lines.en: Conduct training programs to broaden the staff's knowledge and perspective.
lines.style: Back to the authoritative register. This one carries intention beyond the surface order—he believes this matters. Steady cadence. The voice investing in something, not just directing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用車の人身事故ゼロを目標にします
lines.en: Understood. We'll make company vehicle safety and accident prevention our priority.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Clear and committed. The voice closing the meeting—demonstrating he's absorbed everything and has a concrete next step. Respectful, complete, ready to move forward.
